injured_person.CARE: Was it you who got hurt, or someone else? A name or role is fine.

injury_type.CARE: What kind of injury is it, like a cut, burn or fall? You can skip this.

location.PLAIN: Where did this happen? You can say 'here' if it's where you are.
location.CARE: Where did this happen? A rough location is fine, or just say 'here'.

description.CARE: In your own words, what happened? Only share what you're comfortable with.

time.CARE: Do you remember roughly when? An estimate is fine.

immediate_actions.PLAIN: Has anything been done to make the area safe?
immediate_actions.CARE: Has anyone been able to help yet, like first aid or security?

people_involved.CARE: Who was involved? You can also skip this.

lines.opening_one: Got it. Just one quick detail.
lines.opening_many: Got it. Just a couple of quick details.
lines.opening_care: I'm sorry this happened. Thank you for reporting it. I just need a couple of details.
lines.safety_check: Are you somewhere safe right now?
lines.defer: Your safety comes first. We can finish the details later.
lines.readback_plain: Logged: {incident_type}, {location}, {time_phrase}. Please review and tap submit.
lines.readback_care: Thank you. Reporting this helps keep everyone safe. I've logged {summary}. {next_step} Please review and tap submit.
lines.closing_care: Your report is saved. You can add more details any time.
lines.offer_typing: You can also type if you'd prefer.

readout._comment: Spoken read-outs of the Review and Success screens (FormReadout): the complete key set with its English values; other languages copy this object and translate it (placeholders {location} {severity} {fields} {id} {summary} {h} {mm} {time} stay). Keys left out of a language fall back to these.
readout.emergency: Emergency contact numbers are shown after you submit.
readout.tail_flagged: Please review the highlighted fields and tap submit.
readout.submitted_severe: You can call the emergency contacts on screen.
